mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST increases by more than 1% in the prior month, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.25%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that lowers discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2008 recovery regime, rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% per annum signals a strengthening economy and potential for corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in the post-2008 recovery regime when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0%, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing and industrial activity, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% in the prior month, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900 thousand units, it signals a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST exceeds 900.0, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS below 0.5% does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals an overheating labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in the late-cycle expansion regime when UNRATE is below 5.0%, over any 3-year rolling window.
